messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: high-sev - prod GPU capacity exhaustion (us-west-2). Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes, queue growing. Impact: generation timeouts and 5xx for some tenants. Paging oncall @Amber :rotating_light:
Jordan (sre): seen the spike on tx queue. autoscaler logs show repeated AttachRole timeout + launchtemplate mismatch errors.
Amber (oncall): looking now, bringing up kubectl. Can someone share the latest autoscaler logs?
Priya (eng-runtime): tailing autoscaler: `E0905 13:01:02 cluster.go:512] error adding nodegroup: AttachRole timed out` then `warn: launchTemplate version 0.0.0 != expected 2023-09-01`.
Ryan (infra): that LT mismatch came from the last infra rollout earlier today. New nodes are using an older launch template id - ASG not updating due to staged deploy. I'm checking ASG activity.
Marcus (ml-platform): customer-facing queues show backlog rising for embeddings and chat models. Error % increased from 0.5% -> 7% in 5m.
Helena (cs): we are getting one support ticket mentioning timeouts for a high-revenue customer. They report failures around 13:00 UTC. I'll open a bridge for customer updates.
Amber (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) reduce routing to this pool (reroute to dedicated hotpool or other region) 2) attempt manual scale-up of a compatible nodegroup 3) temporarily relax taint enforcement so existing nodes can accept GPU pods. Which can we do fastest?
Jordan (sre): reroute config change is low-risk. Can update route-balance to shift 30% to dedicated. I'll push that.
Ryan (infra): manual ASG scale-up attempt failed: `DesiredCapacityIncreaseRejected: LaunchTemplateVersionNotFound` — ASG references LT version that doesn't exist in the account due to malformed `CreateLaunchTemplateVersion` earlier. Need infra rollback or create matching LT version.
Priya (eng-runtime): relaxing taints requires kubeadm changes; we can patch the nodeSelector/tolerations in the pending pod spec but there are many. Simpler: edit daemonset tolerations? Could add a permissive toleration at the Deployment level for the critical service. Risk: colliding with scheduling for non-GPU pods.
Amber (oncall): OK Jordan, please apply route shift now. Priya, prepare a quick patch to add toleration to the inference Deployment (canary) and we'll roll to 10% first. Marcus, capture a short list of affected customers.
Jordan (sre): route change applied: shifted 30% traffic away from us-west GPU pool to dedicated-us-west. Observability: latency dropped slightly but queue still high.
Marcus (ml-platform): affected tenants: tenant-alpha (high errors), tenant-gamma (partial timeouts). Errors for alpha down from 12% -> 4% after route change.
Helena (cs): notified tenant-alpha of incident and temporary mitigation. They want ETA for full recovery. Please give estimate.
Priya (eng-runtime): pushing a Deployment patch now to add toleration `tolerations: - key: "gpu-pending" operator: "Exists" effect: "NoSchedule"` only for the critical inference deployment. Rolling to 10% canary.
Amber (oncall): canary patched and pods are scheduling onto non-GPU nodes with CPU fallback. Some models degrade but at least not 5xx. Monitoring for errors.
Ryan (infra): short-term infra action: I'll create a new LT version that matches the ASG expected parameters and attach it. That should allow ASG to scale. Doing `aws ec2 create-launch-template-version --launch-template-id lt-xxxx --source-version 1 --launch-template-data '...'`.
Jordan (sre): FYI autoscaler still reporting `scale up blocked: nodegroup maxed` for one GPU pool. We might need to temporarily bump nodegroup max size. Ryan can you update ASG limits?
Ryan (infra): bumping ASG max from 50 -> 80 now. Request submitted, waiting for quota checks.
Marcus (ml-platform): while infra does LT fix, traffic shift + toleration patch reduced customer errors to 1-2%. Good interim stability.
Helena (cs): tenant-alpha acknowledged the workaround. They asked for a postmortem and timeline; flagging for follow-up.
Priya (eng-runtime): ASG accepted new LT version and scale-up initiated. New GPU nodes are launching.
Amber (oncall): seeing nodes register and join. Pods starting to drain backlog. Queue length trending down.
Jordan (sre): confirm autoscaler now accepts new nodes - removing immediate pager. I'll keep monitoring for 30 minutes.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Pager resolved. Root cause suspected: mismatched launch template versions after infra rollout + AttachRole timeouts causing ASG scale rejection. Mitigations applied: traffic reroute, toleration canary, ASG LT creation, bumped ASG max.
Helena (cs): capturing customer impact: tenant-alpha saw ~7 minutes of elevated errors, tenant-gamma ~4 minutes. I'll include that in incident summary.
Marcus (ml-platform): we should run an eval against degraded model fallback to ensure quality regressions were minimal. Adding as action item.
Amber (oncall): action items: 1) infra to verify LT rollout pipeline and add guardrails 2) autoscaler to fail open more gracefully 3) run postmortem and customer-facing summary. I'll hand off to Jordan for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
